reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin that integrates a locally hosted LM Studio OpenAI-compatible server as a selectable chat-model provider.

summaries.zh: 将本地 LM Studio 的 OpenAI 兼容推理服务器接入 DSH，并在模型选择器中提供本地聊天模型。
summaries.en: Connects a local LM Studio OpenAI-compatible inference server to DSH and makes its chat models available in the model picker.

capabilities: Configures an OpenAI-compatible provider route for a local LM Studio server
Connects DSH chat requests to the LM Studio endpoint at 127.0.0.1:1234
Exposes configured local LM Studio models in the DSH model picker
